learning_objective: 💃 Break down the art of movement! Learn the B.A.S.T.E. framework to understand how the body moves through space, time, and energy.

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: नृत्य-रचना (डांस के स्टेप्स और फॉर्मेशन को डिजाइन करना)
मुद्रा या शरीर की स्थिति (खड़े होने या बैठने का तरीका)
गतिशीलता / ऊर्जा (नृत्य में लगाई गई ताकत, जैसे कोमल या आक्रामक)
स्थानिक जागरूकता (मंच और आस-पास की जगह का सही उपयोग)
गति (नृत्य या संगीत के तेज़ या धीमे होने की चाल)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The body is the dancer's instrument. This component focuses on *what* the body is doing—using whole-body movements, isolating specific parts (like just the hands or eyes), and maintaining balance and posture.

Action is *how* the body moves. It includes axial movements (staying in one place, like twisting or stretching) and locomotor movements (traveling across the floor, like running, leaping, or rolling).

Space is *where* the dancer moves. It involves 'Levels' (high jumps, medium standing, low crawling), 'Directions' (forward, backward, diagonal), and 'Pathways' (moving in straight lines or circles across the stage).

Time is *when* the movements happen. It relates to the rhythm, tempo (fast or slow), and phrasing of the dance. A dancer must sync their movements perfectly with the beat of the music or a specific count.

Energy is *how much force* is applied to the movement. A movement can be sharp and explosive (like a punch), or smooth and flowing (like water). Energy gives the dance its emotional weight and texture.

fun_activity.title: ⚡ The Energy Experiment
fun_activity.instructions: Try this: Walk from one end of your room to the other imagining you are made of 'flowing water' (Smooth energy). Now, walk back imagining you are a 'robot glitching' (Sharp, explosive energy). Notice how changing just the 'Energy' completely changes the dance!

exam_tips: 📌 Memorize the acronym B.A.S.T.E: Body, Action, Space, Time, Energy. Be able to write two lines explaining each.
📌 Differentiate between Axial movement (anchored to one spot) and Locomotor movement (traveling through space).
📌 Explain how 'Levels' in space (High, Medium, Low) can show a character's dominance, weakness, or connection to the earth.
quick_recap: ⭐ The components of dance apply to ALL styles, from classical ballet and Kathak to modern hip-hop.
⭐ Synchronization in a group dance requires precise command over the 'Time' component.
⭐ Changing the 'Dynamics/Energy' is the easiest way to change the emotion of a choreography from happy to aggressive.
